title: Checkout architecture
text: The Checkout Service depends on Payments Gateway. Checkout Service stores orders in Orders DB. Orders DB runs on Postgres. Postgres is hosted in Frankfurt Region.

title: Payments overview
text: Payments Gateway forwards card data to Card Vault. Team Falcon owns Payments Gateway. Card Vault is audited by Compliance Office every quarter.

title: Team directory
text: Maria Okafor leads Team Falcon. Team Falcon is on call for Checkout. Jonas Berg leads Team Harbor. Team Harbor operates PG.

title: Incident 2041 postmortem
text: PG failed over to Frankfurt Region during the incident. Checkout returned errors for eleven minutes until connections were re-established. The postmortem recommends shorter connection timeouts in the checkout client.
